about.title: Your Dedicated Technology Partner for Local & Growing Businesses
about.para1: DeliverNow is a modern digital solutions studio established to empower retail shops, agro centers, clinics, and local enterprises with high-performance software, websites, and apps.
about.para2: Our mission is simple: eliminate agency bloat and tech jargon, delivering fast, durable, and practical digital tools that bring customers to your counter and save you hours every day.
about.para3: Even if you have never managed a digital system before, DeliverNow guides you through every milestone and provides complete 1-on-1 operational training.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, straightforward answers about DeliverNow services:

items.q: Will this website or app work smoothly on budget Android phones?
items.a: Yes. All DeliverNow digital systems are engineered specifically for budget smartphones and load in under 2 seconds even on slow mobile data networks.

items.q: We have no prior experience with software. Can our staff operate it?
items.a: Absolutely. Our counter POS software and web tools are designed to be dead-simple and intuitive. We personally train you and your team during onboarding.

items.q: How do we track project updates during development?
items.a: The DeliverNow team communicates directly with you via WhatsApp and phone calls with live milestone previews so you are always in complete control.

items.q: What kind of support is provided after launch?
items.a: We provide dedicated ongoing technical maintenance and prompt assistance via phone and WhatsApp whenever you need tweaks or guidance.
